idea-plugin.name: Syntax AI Chat Boat
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax AI Chat Boat - A powerful local AI assistant for Android Studio.
Developed by Krishna.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.3.0 - Premium UX Update

  • Welcome Screen: Beautiful empty state with quick action chips.
  • Context Transparency: See exactly what file/line the AI is reading via Context Chips.
  • Micro-Animations: Smooth animated typing indicators and auto-scrolling chat history.
  • Hover Polish: Premium hover effects for buttons and glassmorphism UI tweaks.
  • Inline Editor Integration: Highlight code, right-click, and select "Ask Syntax AI..." to have the AI rewrite code directly in your editor.
  • Vision API Support: Upload screenshots by clicking the '📎' button to let the AI see your UI.
  • Autonomous Looping: The AI can now make recursive tool calls to solve complex problems without stopping.
  • Project Scaffolding: AI can now instantly generate multiple directories and files for you in one command.
